critical_code_review_comments: CategorySection.jsx cleanly separates data (CATEGORIES export with slug=collectibles) from presentation (HOME_CATEGORIES maps collectibles->NFT). Downstream consumers (LiveAuctionsSection chip lookup) still resolve slug=collectibles->label='Collectibles' from CATEGORIES — correct.
LiveAuctionsSection empty-state branch: when search keyword is present it renders search-empty with 'No results found.' — matches spec exactly.
CreateAuction dynamic grid class: form.auctionType==='NFT' ? sm:grid-cols-2 : sm:grid-cols-3 keeps layout clean when Condition is hidden.
Anti-sniping input fully removed from the form; behavior preserved server-side (form.antiSniping default '10' still used in insert payload) — good.
Wallet.jsx warning is a single amber card with a concise sentence; no chain id sentence remains. Good.
Profile.jsx Balance card uses semantic label 'Balance' (span) and shows exact 'Monad Network Only' notice. My Wallet header replaces old 'Embedded Wallet' heading.

Non-blocking: on Create Auction the <select> option 'NFT — start from My Collection' contains a <span> inside <option> in the JSX; React logs a hydration console warning ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Cosmetic console noise, does not affect the UI or the tested spec — flagging for main agent's awareness only.
